title: Edge
description: A printed, undirected connection between two board locations. 39 in total: 30 both-era, 8 rail-only, 1 canal-only.

from.description: One endpoint's board-location id. Ordering carries no meaning; every consumer compares both directions.

type.description: Eras in which a link may be built here. "both" for 30 edges; "rail" for 8; "canal" for the single Burton-on-Trent to Walsall edge.

also-connects.description: A third location this one edge touches. Present on exactly one edge (kidderminster-worcester also touches the southern farm brewery) and load-bearing for link scoring and for network presence.
